title: command payload
description: Sent by the platform to dispatch an operation. Commands are persisted on the platform before dispatch and replayed to reconnecting daemons until a terminal state is reached. The daemon commits its local deduplication record before acknowledging; a command whose operation_id is already known with identical content (kind, payload_version, payload, deadline) replays the stored status instead of executing again, while conflicting reuse of an operation_id is a protocol error.
